scope: Pure recipe3 OSCAR online integration; user explicitly says OPTR is disabled. No attention/math/scheduler source changed by this audit. Follow-up authorization permits the explicit-device selection probe seam.

authorized_device_change.note: Parent changed target defaults at user request; excluded from any unchanged-production assertion.

coverage.condition: Qwen3.5/3Next FULL attention dispatch on the pinned native Ascend path, including fused qwen3_5 branch and unfused branch.
coverage.result: Native projection, Q/K norm and RoPE precede self.attn; native sigmoid gate and RowParallel o_proj consume backend output afterward. OSCAR selects AttentionImpl, not a replacement Qwen forward. New test executes native forward AST unchanged and tests gate/projection values and argument ordering.
coverage.limit: QKV fused operation and attention in new test are explicit CPU boundary doubles. Fused NPU arithmetic, full-model logits and HCCL reduction were not executed.

coverage.condition: Recipe3 perhead_center, four global KV heads, TP4 with one local KV head per rank.
coverage.result: CPU executes actual native weight_loader for K and V at ranks0..3; the matching recipe3 Rk/Rv/key_mean is indexed by logical TP rank. Physical devices4..7 do not alter logical rank mapping. TP8 perhead_center is explicitly rejected; no silent replicated-head misassignment.
coverage.limit: No live model checkpoint was loaded. TP8 native without OSCAR is outside this audit.

coverage.condition: Active official BF16 path, current-only or mixed/history attention.
coverage.result: Only K subtracts the head-specific BF16 mean; Q and V do not. Both ordinary and current-only inputs center once. Stored current INT2 and exact window consume the same rotated K/V. Final Rv inverse occurs after source merge, and native gate/o_proj occur after backend return. MTP uses explicit identity+zero mean.
coverage.limit: BF16 centering/rotation introduces known finite-precision differences; the existing #173/#174 current-only experiment is not a newly found issue and is not recommended for re-enabling.

coverage.condition: Native MTP later draft, one token per request, within hooked proposer scope; all reject counts0..3 and mRoPE coordinate offsets.
coverage.result: Accepted logical KV boundary comes from seq_len minus rejected count, independent of RoPE coordinates. Only explicit native discard mask permits padding; invalid live slots remain errors. Fixed source and length allocations preserve graph address ownership; wrap protection remains in place.
coverage.limit: These are existing #157-161 repairs. No new bug or explanation of current evaluation score is established.

coverage.condition: MTP with none or align cache mode, genuine warm speculative-width prompt continuation, including mixed batches and prefix hits.
coverage.result: Existing external hook keeps actual prefill masks/counts and prevents warm qLen4 prompt work entering a decode graph. Normal decode/dummy/capture remain native. Existing reproduction of old uninitialized SSM fold is not reported as a new current bug.

coverage.condition: PC enabled explicitly, native align manager with joint FULL/GDN page geometry; normal request completion/abort/preemption.
coverage.result: Exact snapshots are owned by physical page IDs in native padding; recent+speculative retention protects rollback. Existing checkpoint hook retains native joint prompt checkpoint refs, releases after native free, and preserves native hashing/lookup and normal decode. Tests execute real native manager/pool contracts, including20-request turnover.
coverage.limit: Default config has PC disabled. No evidence this local CPU workload reproduces the user evaluation cache/hit schedule.

coverage.condition: OSCAR_ENABLED=1 and native Triton rejection sampling is available.
coverage.result: Cannot claim that literally all non-attention code is untouched: existing plugin also protects cumulative-pointer backing and implements native greedy-prefix/first-rejection/bonus semantics. Native random probabilities/argmax writer and non-greedy output rows remain preserved by the audited adapter.
coverage.limit: This is a previously documented #157-160 source-risk repair, not a new precision diagnosis.
